From Ascension, for Ascension
Ascension Parish is home for Grow Green. Based in St. Amant, Dereck and the team combine professional lawn treatment with a local office and clear communication throughout the year.
Have a concern between visits? Tell us what you are seeing. We review the issue and your active program, then explain the next step.
Share your street address, mailing city, and ZIP code so we can confirm coverage and scheduling for your property.
Clear answers before you start
What to expect from treatment, follow-up, monthly billing, and getting your lawn ready.

Pre-emergent treatments help control susceptible weeds as they germinate, before they emerge. Post-emergent treatments target weeds that are already growing. The right approach depends on the weed, your grass type, and application conditions.

Our year-round lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. We adjust timing and applications for the season, weather, and turf condition. Your estimate explains the services recommended for your property.

We review the treatable lawn area, property conditions, and requested services to prepare your estimate. The annual eight-visit lawn program is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract.

Response varies with weed species, maturity, temperature, moisture, and lawn condition. Some weeds respond after an application; established or recurring weeds may require continued attention. Your service notes explain what to watch for and how to care for the lawn afterward.

Tell us where those weeds are growing. Recurring sedges may need continued management. Dallisgrass is evaluated for a separate specialty plan, with its scope, timing, and price explained before you approve.

Yes. We work with these warm-season lawn grasses and select treatments for the grass, weed species, and current conditions. Let us know about new sod, seeding, stressed areas, or previous applications before service.

Flower-bed and suitable rock-bed weed control are separate services. Tell us which areas need attention and we can include a separate estimate. Treatments used in lawn grass are not automatically appropriate around ornamental plants.

Usually you do not need to be home if the treatment area is accessible. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share access restrictions. Keep people and pets away during application and follow the product-specific re-entry, watering, and mowing directions we provide.

Contact our office with the location and what you are seeing. We review the concern, check what your active program covers, and explain the next step. Additional or specialty services are discussed before you approve any separate work.

We take requests throughout our Ascension service area, including Gonzales, Prairieville, Dutchtown, Geismar, St. Amant, Sorrento, and Galvez. Enter the city on your property’s mailing address and ZIP code so we can confirm coverage and scheduling.

real_faqs.q: What is the difference between weed prevention and weed treatment?
real_faqs.a: Pre-emergent treatments help control susceptible weeds as they germinate, before they emerge. Post-emergent treatments target weeds that are already growing. The right approach depends on the weed, your grass type, and application conditions.

real_faqs.q: How often will you treat my Ascension lawn?
real_faqs.a: Our year-round lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. We adjust timing and applications for the season, weather, and turf condition. Your estimate explains the services recommended for your property.

real_faqs.q: How is weed control priced and billed?
real_faqs.a: We review the treatable lawn area, property conditions, and requested services to prepare your estimate. The annual eight-visit lawn program is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract.

real_faqs.q: How quickly will I see fewer weeds?
real_faqs.a: Response varies with weed species, maturity, temperature, moisture, and lawn condition. Some weeds respond after an application; established or recurring weeds may require continued attention. Your service notes explain what to watch for and how to care for the lawn afterward.

real_faqs.q: Do you treat nutsedge and dallisgrass?
real_faqs.a: Tell us where those weeds are growing. Recurring sedges may need continued management. Dallisgrass is evaluated for a separate specialty plan, with its scope, timing, and price explained before you approve.

real_faqs.q: Can you treat St. Augustine, centipede, bermuda, and zoysia?
real_faqs.a: Yes. We work with these warm-season lawn grasses and select treatments for the grass, weed species, and current conditions. Let us know about new sod, seeding, stressed areas, or previous applications before service.

real_faqs.q: Is flower-bed weed control included with lawn treatment?
real_faqs.a: Flower-bed and suitable rock-bed weed control are separate services. Tell us which areas need attention and we can include a separate estimate. Treatments used in lawn grass are not automatically appropriate around ornamental plants.

real_faqs.q: Do I need to be home, and what should I do with pets?
real_faqs.a: Usually you do not need to be home if the treatment area is accessible. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share access restrictions. Keep people and pets away during application and follow the product-specific re-entry, watering, and mowing directions we provide.

real_faqs.q: What should I do if weeds return between visits?
real_faqs.a: Contact our office with the location and what you are seeing. We review the concern, check what your active program covers, and explain the next step. Additional or specialty services are discussed before you approve any separate work.

real_faqs.q: Where in Ascension Parish do you provide service?
real_faqs.a: We take requests throughout our Ascension service area, including Gonzales, Prairieville, Dutchtown, Geismar, St. Amant, Sorrento, and Galvez. Enter the city on your property’s mailing address and ZIP code so we can confirm coverage and scheduling.
